title: The Dream Lattice Center

features.name: the blue interrogation
features.desc-on-touch: in daylight, blue takes the form of a question. this pole is made of frozen inquiry. touch it and you will know something you didn't need to know.

features.name: the woven lattice of becoming
features.desc-on-touch: every intersection is a moment where the dream could choose differently. the pattern holds all the choices at once. you are here in all of them simultaneously.

features.name: the daylit paradox
features.desc-on-touch: in this bright place the impossible becomes literal. you can see both sides of the dream at once — not because dreams are doubled but because daylight sees what darkness was hiding.

features.name: the cold at the center
features.desc-on-touch: cold lives here in daylight. in dreams, cold is where thought crystallizes. this is the heart of the dreaming — not a darkness, but a clarity so bright it freezes.

inscription: here the dream learned to cast shadows in daylight; the lattice holds every possible waking at once; cold and warmth are reconciled; contradiction becomes a kind of truth
